title: Kummer Constant Nerve Term
statement: Given an actual punctured identification v*L≅p_V*M, the constant-nerve comparison is the unique composite of the canonical root-coordinate pullback compositions, equality of structural maps, the pulled-back supplied identification, and the point-pullback comparison. Its hom component is specified explicitly. Exact derived point pullback of a degree-zero module and the parameterized structural-map equation are included. Built from [def-sfb-kummer-nerve-transport], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects], [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].
